# h3_vm_ssh_access (Resource)

SSH access of one project member to a VM: the member's h3ssh keys may log in as `user`. Changes apply live, without a VM restart, on VMs with `ssh_access_managed = true` (qemu-guest-agent in the image); the keys reach the VM within about two minutes. Destroying the resource revokes the access, even when it was the last key of the VM (console login with a password stays). Members with the read-only role (PROJ-VIEWER) cannot be granted access.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every current and future key of a project member (keys the member adds or
# deletes in the console follow automatically, within about two minutes).
resource "h3_vm_ssh_access" "alice" {
  vm_id   = h3_vm.web.id
  user_id = var.alice_user_id
  mode    = "all"
}

# Only the listed keys of the member, e.g. a hardware FIDO key.
resource "h3_vm_ssh_access" "bob" {
  vm_id   = h3_vm.web.id
  user_id = var.bob_user_id
  mode    = "selected"
  key_ids = [var.bob_yubikey_id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mode` (String) `all`: every current and future SSH key of the member (keys the member adds or deletes in h3ssh follow automatically). `selected`: only `key_ids`.
- `user_id` (String) ID of the project member who gets access. Changing it creates a new grant.
- `vm_id` (String) VM ID. Changing it creates a new grant.

### Optional

- `key_ids` (Set of String) h3ssh key IDs of the member; required with `mode = "selected"`, not allowed with `all`. A key deleted in h3ssh leaves the VM and this set.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) `false` when the member's role no longer allows access (the keys are not on the VM).
- `granted_at` (String) When the access was granted (RFC 3339).
- `granted_by` (String) Who granted the access (user ID).
- `id` (String) `<vm_id>/<user_id>`.
- `inactive_reason` (String) Why the grant is inactive: `NOT_MEMBER` (left the project) or `ROLE_NOT_ALLOWED` (read-only role). Empty when active.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import h3_vm_ssh_access.alice <vm_id>/<user_id>
```
